title: The Ark Brought to Jerusalem

questions.question: Who did David say ought to carry the ark of God?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:2 (ESV): "...No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God..."

questions.question: What did David prepare for the ark of God?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:1 (ESV): "...and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it."

questions.question: How did the Levites carry the ark this time?
options: On their shoulders with the poles
questions.correctAnswer: On their shoulders with the poles
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:15 (ESV): "And the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles..."

questions.question: What was David clothed in?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:27 (ESV): "David was clothed with a robe of fine linen..."

questions.question: Who despised David in her heart?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:29 (ESV): "...Michal the daughter of Saul... saw King David dancing and celebrating, and she despised him in her heart."

questions.question: Who were the chiefs of the Levites David summoned?
options: Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab
questions.correctAnswer: Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:11 (ESV): "David summoned the priests Zadok and Abiathar, and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab."

questions.question: What were the singers to play loudly?
options: Musical instruments, harps and lyres and cymbals
questions.correctAnswer: Musical instruments, harps and lyres and cymbals
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:16 (ESV): "...play loudly on musical instruments, harps and lyres and cymbals..."

questions.question: Who was Chenaniah?
options: Leader of the Levites in music
questions.correctAnswer: Leader of the Levites in music
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:22 (ESV): "Chenaniah, leader of the Levites in music, should direct the music..."

questions.question: How many rams and bulls were sacrificed when God helped the Levites?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:26 (ESV): "...they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams."

questions.question: What did David also wear besides the robe?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:27 (ESV): "...David also wore a linen ephod."

questions.question: Who sounded the bronze cymbals?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:19 (ESV): "The singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were to sound bronze cymbals."

questions.question: Who were the doorkeepers for the ark?
options: Berechiah and Elkanah (and later Obed-edom and Jehiah)
questions.correctAnswer: Berechiah and Elkanah (and later Obed-edom and Jehiah)
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:23-24 (ESV): "Berechiah and Elkanah were to be gatekeepers for the ark... Obed-edom and Jehiah were to be gatekeepers for the ark."

questions.question: Why did the Lord break out against them before?
options: Because they did not carry the ark according to the rule
questions.correctAnswer: Because they did not carry the ark according to the rule
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:13 (ESV): "...the LORD our God broke out against us, because we did not seek him according to the rule."

questions.question: Which instrument did Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth... play?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:20 (ESV): "...were to play harps according to Alamoth."

questions.question: Who blew the trumpets before the ark?
options: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer
questions.correctAnswer: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:24 lists the priests who blew the trumpets.

key_verse_text: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, to the sound of the horn, trumpets, and cymbals, and making loud music on harps and lyres.
